1.title: John Fetterman’s Popularity With Republicans Surges, Poll Finds
1.summary: Pennsylvania Republicans now view John Fetterman, the state’s Democratic senator, more favorably than its sitting G.O.P. senator, a New York Times/Philadelphia Inquirer/Siena poll found.

2.title: Hegseth’s Purge of Top Generals Leaves the Army Rudderless
2.summary: The leadership vacuum comes as the Army is trying to adapt to a new kind of war dominated by deadly drones.

3.title: Trump says all mines cleared from Strait of Hormuz
3.summary: Iran has closed the vital waterway since the beginning of the conflict causing wild fluctuations in oil prices worldwide.

4.title: CIA chief travels to Moscow for unannounced talks, US media reports
4.summary: Flight tracking data confirms an American military aircraft travelled to Russia from the US via Latvia on Tuesday.

5.title: Two unvaccinated people die of measles in Pennsylvania
5.summary: Cases in the US have hit the highest point since the virus was eliminated, as vaccination rates decline.

6.title: Canada Fires Back in Trade War Against Trump With Up to 50% Tariffs
6.summary: Canada said the higher levies, on items from aluminum foil to dishwashers to fish, would help protect workers, producers and manufacturers harmed by new Trump tariffs.
